item.title: @faytuksnetwork: Israeli and Lebanese delegations met at CENTCOM headquarters at MacDill AFB in Tampa, today. They want to work out a fra
item.description: Israeli and Lebanese delegations met at CENTCOM headquarters at MacDill AFB in Tampa, today. They want to work out a framework in which Lebanese forces take over for IDF troops as they are withdrawn, with the true purpose of suppressing and sidelining Hezbollah.
item.content:encoded:
@faytuksnetwork

Israeli and Lebanese delegations met at CENTCOM headquarters at MacDill AFB in Tampa, today. They want to work out a framework in which Lebanese forces take over for IDF troops as they are withdrawn, with the true purpose of suppressing and sidelining Hezbollah.

item.title: @faytuksnetwork: Two teenage girls were killed and six others wounded when Houthi forces struck a residential neighborhood in Taiz on Tue
item.description: Two teenage girls were killed and six others wounded when Houthi forces struck a residential neighborhood in Taiz on Tuesday, AP reports. Civilians face grave risks as Houthi forces encircle the city and restrict essential supplies.
item.content:encoded:
@faytuksnetwork

item.description: 🇴🇲 🇬🇧 Sultan Haitham bin Tarik of Oman arrived in London today for a 72 hour official visit. He’ll meet with UK PM Burnham tomorrow. London is expected to reaffirm commitments to Oman’s security, including their naval facilities at Duqm.
